label: SELF-WORTH

cover.headline: 5 small rituals that *rebuild you*
cover.sub: For the weeks after a breakup.

points.heading: A slow morning drink
points.body: Five quiet minutes before your phone.
points.panel: Make your favorite drink and sit with it, no scrolling.

points.heading: A daily walk
points.body: Movement and fresh air help steady your mood.
points.panel: Take a 15-minute walk at the same time each day.

points.heading: Three good things
points.body: Notice what went okay, even on hard days.
points.panel: Write down three small good things each evening.

points.heading: A weekly treat
points.body: Something to look forward to, just for you.
points.panel: Book one small treat for this weekend.

points.heading: Wind down kindly
points.body: Gentle evenings help you sleep and heal.
points.panel: Dim the lights and read for 20 minutes before bed.

close.save: Save this for the rebuilding weeks.

caption:
After a breakup, the big changes can feel overwhelming. Small, steady rituals are often what rebuild you, one day at a time.

These five take only minutes, but together they help you feel grounded, cared for, and a little more like yourself again. Start with just one.

Save this for the rebuilding weeks, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
